note: Cool shonen chibi avatar art, full body (original; style B approved 2026-10-09, full body + poses + props 2026-10-10). A stored avatar is [styleIndex, ...one option index per part in that style's partOrder]. Links depend on this: never reorder or remove styles, parts or options; only append. SVG fragments use {skin} {skinShade} {skinDeep} {hair} {hairShade} {hairLight} {brow} {shirt} {shirtShade} {shirtLight} {line} colour placeholders; viewBox is 0 0 200 320 (head in the top 0-145). Hair options may have back / shade / front slots. Tops have main + sleeve (long/short/none) and optional sleeveColor. Bottoms have stand + wide (for the wide pose stance). Shoes are one shoe centred on x=0 (toe to the right); the left foot is mirrored. Poses give elbow/hand points per arm, a hand shape, a stance and which hand holds the type prop.
